notes.title: Cat Tower Might Release Before 6969
notes.content:
[h1]A releaser date closer than expected.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40989927/0c13dcb0b2fd968455a78f95eae9a2f97ab8e237.png[/img]
[u][i]It's winter in Brazil but its still very hot in the north and center-west, lucky i'm not there, poor guys.[/i][/u]


Hello whoever this announcement might reach, after a long deliberation I have decided to release Cat Tower sooner than I originally expected. 

At the time I am planning to release it early in 2025, however the final date might be earlier of later, once I'm confident about the release date I'll change it but for now let's leave it at 6969, I think it's a neat number.

I also changed a few things about the steam page, rewritten some stuff to make the game sound less silly as of right now the game ended up with a more serious tone than expected.

Also added quality artwork to it.

Thanks for reading and have a good day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40989927/23c8855e4738695a2c06f135536b36caeef4b43e.png[/img]
[i][u]Unused Cat Tower asset, a pin up from a catlike magic character[/u][/i]
